limitations: This is a dirty local 5.0.0 source candidate; no commit, push, tag, npm publication, GitHub Release, deployment, or real user installation was performed.
No live provider, credentials, paid call, or Host ACP conformance drill was used; protocol execution evidence uses the fake ACP agent and every shipped Host remains on CLI fallback.
ZCode uses the installed Desktop runtime only and remains experimental; no activated ACP bridge or recovery drill is claimed.
No Windows descendant-process cleanup proof is claimed from this POSIX environment.
The npm dry run warns that .gitignore is used because .npmignore is absent; the explicit files allowlist and inspected 138-entry inventory are the accepted packaging boundary.
The strict review ran sequentially in shared context and has no independent model-family boundary.
